hooks.command: repo=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#.*[:/]([^/]+/[^/]+)(\.git)?$#\1#; s/\.git$//'); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ "$branch" = "main" ] && exit 0; [ -z "$repo" ] && exit 0; state=$(gh pr view "$branch" --repo "$repo" --json state --jq '.state' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$state" = "MERGED" ] || [ "$state" = "CLOSED" ]; then jq -n --arg branch "$branch" --arg state "$state" --arg repo "$repo" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Branch " + $branch + " already has a " + $state + " PR on " + $repo + " — committing here will strand the work. Fetch origin/main and create a fresh branch instead.")}}'; fi
